ideas.title: Minnesota Human Services Fraud: A 50-Year Problem
ideas.description: Investigate the groundwork for fraud in Minnesota human services and the role of leadership in perpetuating or addressing the issue.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the accountability of Minnesota's Department of Human Services
questions: What is the extent of fraud in Minnesota human services?
How has leadership contributed to or addressed the issue?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the long-standing issue of fraud in Minnesota human services and the role of leadership in perpetuating or addressing the problem. It would require following the money and examining the accountability of the state's Department of Human Services.
